build_simple_mlp: build a deterministic MLP with from_config using feature_sizes like [8, 16, 32, 32]
build_dropout_mlp: build a DropoutMLP with from_config specifying feature_sizes and drop_rate for stochastic layers
test_check_layer: test a layer by tracing with check_layers_by_tracing.check_layer using a sample input array
test_train_mlp: train a deterministic MLP on XOR data using basic_training.build_train_step_fn and TrainState
test_with_random_key: test a model with random keys using pz.de.WithRandomKeyFromArg.handling to wrap the model
